column1: # Corrections cleared for writing. Tab separated: title, wrong, right.
# The harvest proposes; this file decides. Roughly half of what it proposes
# is wrong, because the local evidence cannot distinguish a name the show
# spells oddly from a name a subtitle got wrong - "Barbas" is right and the
# only Charmed subtitle carrying it says "Barbus". Everything here was
# checked against what the title actually calls these people and places.
# Deliberately NOT approved, as examples of what the harvest gets wrong:
#   Charmed        Barbas -> Barbus        Barbas is the demon's name
#   Sons of Anarchy Diosa -> Deosa         Diosa is the business
#   Mayday         Pitot -> Pettit         a pitot tube
#   Mayday         Nepalese -> Nepals      an ordinary word
#   The Good Doctor Anastomosis -> Anastomos   a real surgical term
#   South Park     MPAA -> Moop            MPAA is real
#   Peacemaker     Murn -> Mern            Murn is right
#   Smallville     Kel-El -> Kai-El        it is Kal-El, neither of these
#   Stargate       Tok'rin -> Tok'erne     Danish leaking into English
